hero.descriptionText: We’re a community building event. No attitudes. Just friendly people, warm coffee, and amazing machines on local streets.

pillars.title: It's About People
pillars.description: We care about the people, not what you ride. Bring a custom chopper, a modern scooter, or just bring a friend on foot. No status, no egos.

pillars.title: Supporting Local Coffee
pillars.description: Every event happens at a local independent cafe, showcasing independent coffee shops and boosting local neighborhood business models.

pillars.title: A Global Network
pillars.description: From Montreal to Cape Town, thousands of riders meet monthly. Our global community stays connected through simple local passions.

about.subheadingText: Founded on sidewalk curbs in Toronto, we believe human connection and friendliness can exist effortlessly on public city streets.
about.quoteText: We wanted to build the community we wished existed.
about.narrativeP1: In 2013, founders Viktor and Samantha Radics noticed that while Toronto had plenty of motorcycle clubs, there wasn’t a low-pressure, open platform where everyday folks could gather simply to chat, network, and support independent coffee.
about.narrativeP2: They picked a favorite local coffee shop, spread the word on social media, and parked their custom bikes. Fifteen people showed up. They shared stories, admired the mechanics, and parted as friends. By the end of the summer, those 15 had turned into 150. Today, those circles represent thousands of participants in cities worldwide.

pillars.title: Inclusivity
pillars.description: Everyone is welcome. Egos stay home.

pillars.title: Midweek
pillars.description: Breaks the grind on evening schedules.

quotes.text: We don't care what you ride. We care who you are. The motorcycle is simply the vehicle that parks us on the same sidewalk.
quotes.author: THE CORE MANIFESTO

quotes.text: Egos stay at home. Sidewalk curbs are flat, and so is our community — no hierarchies, no prerequisites, just coffee and smiles.
quotes.author: OUR COMMONS CREED

quotes.text: Built on friendliness, fueled by caffeine, and sustained by the simple act of showing up midweek to break the daily grind.
quotes.author: THE MIDWEEK PROTOCOL

quotes.text: Whether you roll in on a custom chopper, a vintage scooter, or walk over in a business suit — you have a place on our curb.
quotes.author: THE OPEN ACCESSION

events.subheadingText: We gather monthly on curbsides and friendly parking spots. Slide through our active calendar of meets below.
events.footnoteText: Let's build a safe, welcoming evening together. Drive your car, ride your motorcycle, scooter, or just drop by on foot to enjoy hot caffeine cups and zero-egos conversations.

sponsors.subheadingText: We partner with progressive brands who believe in our absolute core values: inclusion, genuine warmth, and premium offline coffee hospitality.
sponsors.ctaText: Whether you are an independent local roastery, a classic gear artisan, or an established global brand, help us power warm sidewalk cafes and bring people together offline.

collaborators.subheadingText: Shiny Side Connects is made possible by welcoming coordinators, photographers, and hospitable minds worldwide. Meet the 9 central collaborators who host monthly sidewalk espresso gatherings, build warm spaces, and keep egos out of the loop.
collaborators.ctaText: Want to co-host, photograph local events, or run social media outreach for your city? Submit your questionnaire and help us build friendly sidewalk circles.
